headlines.text: Looking back to 2022, when it was Penta Oscuro's first night in AEW, appearing on Dynamite, rated 5.59.
Rewind to 2024, when Private Party & Sydal arrived in AEW as a team, appearing on Rampage, rated 6.19.
On this day in 2022, Bryan Danielson vs. Daniel Garcia locked horns for the first time, in the show-closing main event slot on Dynamite, rated 7.32 ? a strong outing.

secondaries.text: Back on this day in 2022, reDRagon vs. 2.O vs. Best Friends vs. FTR vs. Proud-N-Powerful vs. Private Party vs. The Butcher and The Blade vs. Dark Order (Reynolds & Silver) vs. The Gunn Club vs. The Young Bucks settled things in a Battle Royal match, setting the tone as the night's opener on Dynamite, rated 6.35.
